mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast_device_log_version(tenant_id,device_id,current_version) VALUES(#{query.tenantId},#{query.deviceId},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_version=current_version+1
mapper.select: SELECT current_version FROM ast_device_log_version WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND device_id=#{query.deviceId} FOR UPDATE
